Switch from an initial scalar to a final scalar at the step time.

GraphExecutor evaluates the initial value before step_time seconds and the final value at and after that time.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [Signal](../categories/signal.md) |
| Status | Runs |
| Also read from graphs as | `StepSignal` |
| Search words | signal, step, simulation |

## Inputs

None: the node starts a branch of the graph.

## Outputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Signal** | Tensor | Yes | 1 | Scalar step-signal sample |

## Settings

| Group | Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Step | Step time (s) | `step_time` | Number | `1.0` | `>= 0` | The run | Transition time in seconds. |
| Step | Initial value | `initial_value` | Number | `0.0` |   | The run | Value before the transition. |
| Step | Final value | `final_value` | Number | `1.0` |   | The run | Value at and after the transition. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

## Where it runs

| Where | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| Data pipeline (run the graph, **Run step**, previews) | No: StepSignal belongs to the GraphExecutor scalar simulation lane; PipelineExecutor does not execute time-varying simulation sources |

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.

## Support

| Aspect | Value | Supported | Why |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Runtime | fail closed | No | StepSignal belongs to the GraphExecutor scalar simulation lane; PipelineExecutor does not execute time-varying simulation sources |
| Fail Mode | hard fail | No | As above |
| Pipeline Executor | unsupported | No | As above |
| Materializer | none | No | As above |
| Implementation Owner | graph executor | Yes | GraphExecutor owns bounded scalar control evaluation for the live simulation lane; PipelineExecutor and the training backend reject it. |
| Support State | real | Yes | As above |
| Workflow Lane | simulation | Yes | As above |
| Simulation Runtime | supported | Yes | As above |
